title: The Maharashtra Assembly, Before and After 2008
name: Maharashtra
intro: For three decades, Maharashtra was fought on the 288 constituencies of the 1978 delimitation order. The 2008 order redrew all of them.
The assembly map Maharashtra retired in 2008

constituencies.name: Sawantwadi
constituencies.note: Abolished. The old Sawantwadi constituency disappeared after Sindhudurg became a separate district. The Mandangad area and parts of Khed from the former Sawantwadi constituency were reorganised to form the new Dapoli constituency.
constituencies.extent: Sawantwadi tahsil; and Mangaon RIC in Kudal tahsil.

constituencies.name: Vengurla
constituencies.note: Abolished. Areas of the former Vengurla constituency lying in present Ratnagiri district (mainly parts of Khed and Guhagar side) were reorganised into the newly constituted Guhagar constituency, while the remaining area stayed in Sindhudurg.
constituencies.extent: Vengurla tahsil; and Kudal tahsil (excluding Mangaon RIC).

constituencies.name: Malvan

constituencies.extent: Malwan tahsil (excluding Shravan RIC); and Kankavali RIC and villages in Nandgaon RIC specified in item (1) of the Appendix in Kankavali tahsil.

constituencies.name: Devgad
constituencies.note: Abolished in Ratnagiri district. The Shravan RIC, Deogad Tahsil and Nandgaon RIC portions earlier attached to Deogad were transferred to the new Ratnagiri constituency, while Deogad itself became part of Sindhudurg district.
constituencies.extent: Shravan RIC in Malwan tahsil; Deogad tahsil; and Nandgaon RIC [excluding villages specified in item (1) of the Appendix] in Kankavali tahsil.

constituencies.name: Rajapur
constituencies.note: Retained but extensively reorganised. Earlier based mainly on Rajapur Tahsil and Lanja RIC. After delimitation it comprises Rajapur Tahsil, Lanja Tahsil and part of Sangameshwar Tahsil (Kondgaon Revenue Circle) instead of the earlier RIC arrangement.
constituencies.extent: Rajapur tahsil; and Bhambed RIC in Lanja tahsil.

constituencies.name: Ratnagiri
constituencies.note: Retained with major boundary revision. Earlier consisted almost entirely of Ratnagiri Tahsil. After delimitation it also includes Sangameshwar Tahsil areas transferred from the former Deogad constituency.
constituencies.extent: Ratnagiri tahsil.

constituencies.name: Sangameshwar
constituencies.extent: Sangameshwar tahsil (excluding Makhajan RIC) and Lanja tahsil (excluding Bhambed RIC).

constituencies.name: Guhagar
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Earlier based on Guhagar Tahsil plus Rampur and Makhajan RICs. After 2008 it includes entire Guhagar Tahsil, parts of Khed Tahsil and parts of Chiplun Tahsil using Revenue Circles instead of RICs.
constituencies.extent: Guhagar tahsil; and Rampur RIC in Chiplun tahsil and Makhajan RIC in Sangameshwar tahsil.

constituencies.name: Chiplun
constituencies.note: Retained but extensively reorganised. Earlier mainly covered Chiplun Tahsil. The new constituency additionally includes Chiplun Municipal Council, parts of Sangameshwar Tahsil and specified Revenue Circles, while some old areas shifted to Guhagar and Ratnagiri.
constituencies.extent: Chiplun tahsil (excluding Rampur RIC).

constituencies.name: Khed
constituencies.note: Abolished. The old Khed constituency ceased to exist. Its territory was divided mainly between the new Dapoli and Guhagar constituencies, with Revenue Circles redistributed according to the 2008 delimitation.
constituencies.extent: Khed tahsil; and Dabhol RIC [excluding villages specified in item (2) of the Appendix] in Dapoli tahsil.

constituencies.name: Dapoli

constituencies.extent: Villages in Dabhol RIC specified in item (2) of the Appendix, Dapoli RIC, and Palgad RIC, in Dapoli tahsil; and Mandangad tahsil.

constituencies.name: Mahad

constituencies.name: Mangaon

constituencies.name: Pen
